bosses._lore: Netch are native to Morrowind and Solstheim (UESP Lore:Netch); the lore places none in Skyrim or Blackreach. Ours: a bull the Dwemer of Solstheim (Nchardak, Kagrumez) grafted with brass bellows and pipes. In the Ashlands it is a wild bull gone strange; in Blackreach it is the reason a netch is there at all, kept or carried down by the Dwemer. Calves under threat oil the air and drive a bull to frenzy (UESP), which is why the netchlings come in waves. Shape after Nat's pick of ESO's Grobull the Transmuted (the Leader, 2 Nov), with our own name and lines.
bosses._laterIdea: Grobull's 'plays dead until you come close' opening is not in bosses.js: openingDelaySeconds only delays the adds. A later idea needs code (a passive or downed boss until a player is within a radius).

spot.note: Solstheim's southern Ashlands (a vanilla Bull Netch's placement, Dragonborn 030F39; volcanic-ash weather), 5+ cells from Raven Rock and clear of every Baan Malur region

announce.spawn: A low brass hum carries over the ash: Bellowsback drifts again, its calves close about it.
announce.death: Bellowsback sinks into the ash, and its bellows breathe out one last time.

_altSpot.why: The other candidate. A boss has one world (bosses.js writes its zones with b.world; config spot picks only among spots in that world), so Nat's pick is made here: to move it, put this world, spot and announce in place of the Blackreach ones and rebuild. Solstheim is also closed by the region lock (playtest.closedPlugins), as Karstaag is, so it could not go live there yet.
